import json
from scipy.special import erf
gelu=lambda x: 0.5*x*(1+erf(x/np.sqrt(2)))
k=np.load('kernel_v3.npz'); f3=np.load('my3_feats.npz')
C=k['C']; yc=k['yc']; n=1496
Call=np.vstack([C,f3['Z']]); yall=np.concatenate([yc,f3['y']]); src=np.concatenate([np.zeros(n),np.ones(len(yc)-n),2*np.ones(len(f3['y']))]).astype(int)
G=Call@Call.T/768
def cv(w_old,w_new,lam,beta=1.0,seeds=6,ret=False):
    K=gelu(beta*G); accs=[]; Ps=[]
    for seed in range(seeds):
        f=np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(n)%5; P=np.zeros((n,8))
        for j in range(5):
            trp=np.where(f!=j)[0]; te=np.where(f==j)[0]
            tr=np.concatenate([trp, np.where(src>0)[0]])
            w=np.where(src[tr]==0,1.0,np.where(src[tr]==1,w_old,w_new)); tr=tr[w>0]; w=w[w>0]
            Tm=np.eye(8)[yall[tr]]; b=(w[:,None]*Tm).sum(0)/w.sum()
            A=np.linalg.solve(K[np.ix_(tr,tr)]+lam*np.diag(1/w),Tm-b); P[te]=K[np.ix_(te,tr)]@A+b
        accs.append((P.argmax(1)==yall[:n]).mean()); Ps.append(P)
    return (np.mean(accs),Ps) if ret else round(np.mean(accs),4)
for lam in [0.02,0.03,0.05,0.08]:
    print(lam, cv(0.3,0.3,lam), cv(0.2,0.4,lam), cv(0.3,0.3,lam,beta=0.7), cv(0.3,0.3,lam,beta=1.4))
